name: Min Max Step Controller
author: Techplnt

sections.description:
Min Max Step Controller for WooCommerce allows you to set minimum quantity, maximum quantity, and step/increment value for products in your WooCommerce store.

This plugin gives full control over product quantity input—ensuring customers purchase within your required limits. It works best for wholesale stores, bulk product stores, or stores that need fixed quantity increments.

You can set rules globally or override them on a per-product basis.

🌐Demo| 📄Documentation 🚀 |Get Pro Version

✨ Features

  • Set global min quantity for all products.
  • Set global max quantity for all products.
  • Set global step value (e.g., allow purchase only in steps of 5, 10, 20).
  • Override settings on individual products.
  • Automatically controls product quantity input on product pages & cart.
  • Works with all modern WooCommerce themes.
  • Lightweight and performance-optimized.

✨Pro Features:

✅ product’s Quantity Limits.
✅ Set unique min, max and step values for each product.
✅ Set quantity limits by category.
✅ Apply specific rules to targeted product groups.
✅ Set quantity rules individually for each product variation.
✅ Set quantity step decimal.
✅ Allow orders like 0.5kg, 1.75L or 2.25m with precise control

💼 Use Cases

  • Wholesale stores (e.g., minimum quantity 10)
  • Bulk item sales (e.g., step quantity 5)
  • Limit purchases for special items
  • Force customers to buy predefined order quantities
sections.installation:
1. Upload min-max-step-controller folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Min/Max Step to configure global rules.
  4. Edit any product → Product Data → Min/Max Step tab to set product-specific rules.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all themes?

Yes. It works with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.

Can I override global settings on a per-product basis?

Yes. Each product has its own Min/Max Step settings panel.

Does this plugin modify WooCommerce core files?

No. It only uses safe WooCommerce hooks.
